criteria.change_triviality: Ordinal 0–4 assessment of the actual diff: higher scores mean less trivial changes; scores 0–1 are trivial.
criteria.summary-section: Description contains a populated level-two Summary section.
criteria.review-coverage: Supplied review addresses every substantive change; not_assessable when no review is supplied or its references cannot be tied to the patches. It describes the review, not the PR text, so it never contributes to expected_quality.
criteria.title_format: Title follows the router's Conventional Commits syntax.
criteria.title_meaningful: Title conveys an intelligible change rather than gibberish.
criteria.title_diff_consistency: Meaningful title agrees with the actual diff.
criteria.description_present: Body contains substantive prose rather than only placeholders/headings.
criteria.rationale: Body explains a concrete reason for the actual changes, rather than restating them.
criteria.changes_described: Body concretely describes changes; factual accuracy is assessed separately.
criteria.description_title_consistency: Body's change claims agree with the title.
criteria.description_commit_consistency: Body's change claims agree with all commit messages.
criteria.description_diff_consistency: Body accurately covers substantive diff changes, including removals.
criteria.limitations: Body identifies relevant scope boundaries, risks, or limitations.
criteria.breaking_changes: Body accurately discloses and explains migration for an incompatible change.
criteria.testing: Body describes relevant validation or a specific reason testing does not apply.

levels.label: editorial
levels.description: Prose or link correction with no runtime or interface change.

levels.label: mechanical
levels.description: Localized mechanical or presentation edit in code; functional behavior and public interfaces are preserved.

levels.label: bounded_behavior
levels.description: Localized behavior or configuration change requiring edge-case review.

levels.label: substantive
levels.description: New capability or security-sensitive behavior requiring broader review.

levels.label: incompatible
levels.description: Removal of, or incompatible change to, a supported public interface or configuration requiring migration.
